Dr. Srikanth Goud TRS MLC Candidate Exclusive Interview | MLC Elections | Kavitha | Revanth | KTR 


First Candidate Announcement: Dr. Nalamasa Srikanth Goud shares his journey as the first-ever announced MLC candidate for the Khammam-Warangal-Nalgonda Graduates' constituency under K. Kavitha's newly emerged political platform, Telangana Rakshana Sena.

Humble Roots & Activism Background: Highlights his origin from a marginal BC weaver family, his early days in the 2009 Kakatiya University separate Telangana agitation, and facing severe hardships.

Blasting BRS & Congress: Strongly criticizes the previous BRS government and current Congress regime over rampant paper leaks, delayed job notifications, increasing retirement age issues, and the failure to fulfill promises made to unemployed youth and graduates.

Challenging Money Politics: Discusses how traditional parties rely heavily on immense wealth and corporate power, whereas his candidacy aims to bring a revolutionary change by standing up as a direct voice for the common student and common man.

The Vision of K. Kavitha: Explains how K. Kavitha's 20-year grassroots connection through Telangana Jagruthi and her commitment to uplifting ordinary fighters and marginalized communities form the core strength of their political journey.

recentItems.description:
#journalistswapna #SoniaGandhi #TheBelonging #SureshKochattil #BookControversy #IndianPolitics #PoliticalAnalysis #HistoryWhitewash #LatestInterviews
Sonia Gandhi's 'The Belonging' book controversy! Explained By Suresh Kochattil | Sanjeev Gandhi 

Book Release & Rushed Narrative: Analyzes the launch of Sonia Gandhi's autobiography The Belonging, suggesting it was rushed ahead of elections and likely assisted by writers like Jairam Ramesh due to translation and drafting patterns.

Factual & Historical Errors: Points out glaring discrepancies in the book, such as incorrect dates for the founding of the RSS, Anna Hazare's movement, and confusing state capitals like Ahmedabad with Gandhinagar.

Shifting Blame on Sanjay Gandhi: Critiques the attempt to pin the excesses of the Emergency solely on Sanjay Gandhi, arguing it serves as a convenient narrative to shield leadership.

The 1984 Sikh Massacre & Shah Bano Controversy: Examines the severe criticism surrounding the minimization of the 1984 anti-Sikh riots, contrasting it with historical findings, alongside the political handling of the Shah Bano case.

The Prime Ministerial Succession Debate: Recalls historical accounts regarding the transition of power, political advice, and the legal constraints surrounding foreign citizenship during high-level appointments.

recentItems.description:
#ArvindKejriwal #LawrenceBishnoi #BishnoiGang #AAP #ExtortionThreat #IndianPolitics #BreakingNews
Arvind Kejriwal & Daughter Get De*th Threat: 7 కోట్లు ఇస్తారా ? చస్తారా? | Kejriwal news today 


The Extortion Threat: A person claiming to be a member of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang issued a severe death threat demanding an extortion amount of ₹7 crore.   Targets of the Threat: The threat specifically named AAP National Convenor and former Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal along with his daughter, Harshita Kejriwal.   Source of Complaint: AAP MLA Jarnail Singh filed a formal police complaint in Mohali after receiving threatening phone calls and WhatsApp messages.   Police Action & Investigation: Mohali Police registered a case under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and the IT Act, handing the probe over to the Cyber Crime cell to trace IP logs and call records.   Wider Concerns: The incident brings fresh focus to the growing security concerns surrounding the continuous misuse of the Bishnoi gang's name in high-profile threats and extortion calls.

మహబూబాబాద్ జిల్లాలో ఘోర రోడ్డు ప్రమాదం..| Mahabubabad Tragic Road incident | mahabubabd news today


Incident Overview: A horrific road accident occurred near Lacha Thanda in Maripeda mandal of Mahabubabad district, where a speeding car rammed into a motorcycle.   Casualties: A married couple, identified as Banoth Sama (50) and his wife Padma (40) from Lacha Thanda, died on the spot due to severe injuries.   Heartbreaking Background: The tragedy struck the family with immense grief as the couple met with the fatal accident just days before their son's scheduled engagement ceremony.   Crash Dynamics: According to police reports, the speeding car coming from Suryapet hit their bike, throwing both vehicles off-road into nearby agricultural fields.   Police Action: Local police and SHO B. Venkanna rushed to the spot, registered a case, and shifted the bodies to Mahabubabad Area Hospital for post-mortem, while investigations are ongoing
